build.note: Read from saved raw captures; no export, no new capture.

question: For the 63 site weapons, their GS firing data and their bullet files, does any registry default differ from the value stored in the owning file, as it does for vehicles and gadgets (L3314, L3356)?

sourceFacts.method: Every registry row of GRX_Weapons and the other registries whose name starts with a saved weapon file (_WB), firing-data file (GS_) or bullet file (PD_) was grouped by row suffix. For each suffix the own field is the decoded leaf path that equals the registry default on the most owners; every owner was then compared on that path with a float32 comparison. Rows under WeaponModifierDataAssets were left out (their owners are attachment packages, not the weapon). Site owners are the 63 crosswalk weapons' WB and GS files and the 64 projectile files of the site's ballistics.json.

control.description: The method reproduces yesterday's results: muzzle velocity own path Class_35259f6b/Field_58d70acb/Field_0bf4f62b/Field_32a99b9c (L3360) on 63 of 63 weapons, and it finds the known vehicle disagreements (MBT HE inner blast radius 2.25 against 1, L3356). The rate-of-fire, reload and magazine paths it selects are the names already in FIELD_MAP.md.

inference: For the site's weapons, firing data and bullets the registry default and the own value are the same number on every compared row. The registry-or-own question that matters for vehicles and gadgets does not arise for these files, so site values taken from the own fields need no change on that ground.

All differences found by the same pass are on gadget, launcher and vehicle owners. 40 of the 74 are not in the L3314 census list; they are recorded for the vehicle and gadget work and were not examined here.
unresolved: Rows under WeaponModifierDataAssets (attachment package priorities) were not compared.
Rows whose default is not a single number (curve point lists such as TweakableDamageCurve.XYValues) were not compared here; L3359 compared four bolt-action curves.
Site owners without a registry row or a saved file: WB: none; GS: GS_BREN3; PD: PD_545x39mm_MG, PD_9x39mm_Match, PD_9x39mm_Semi.
Equality of the two stored numbers says nothing about which one a live match reads.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Registry default equals the own value on every compared row of the 63 site weapons, their firing data and their bullets (14838 values, 0 differing)
leads.summary: Registry defaults were compared with own values for the 63 site weapons' WB and GS files and the site's bullet files: 14838 values over 60 + 206 + 13 row names, 0 differing. The differences the same pass finds are all on gadget, launcher or vehicle owners (74 rows, 40 not in the L3314 census). 1488 raw-offset checks matched.

leads.statusNote: No registry-versus-own difference on any site weapon row.
